videos.title: GTA 6 Just Broke a 4-Year Twitch Record 📺 #gta6 #shorts
videos.description:
Trackers say GTA 6 peaked at about 3.3 million concurrent Twitch viewers hours into its rollout, beating League of Legends' 3.1 million from Nov 2022. Across all platforms, StreamsCharts reported a preliminary ~6.4 million; Twitch hasn't officially confirmed it.

Sources: Dot Esports, esports.gg, LibertyCity.net (SullyGnome, StreamsCharts data)

videos.title: GTA 6 Reviews Tied the Highest Score Ever 🏆 #gta6 #shorts
videos.description:
GTA 6 reviews went live Nov 18: a 99 on Metacritic, tied with Ocarina of Time for the highest ever, plus perfect 10s from IGN and GameSpot. The most common complaint is the 30 FPS cap.

Sources: Bloomberg, Vice, Dot Esports, Metacritic

videos.title: GTA 6 Made $1.5 Billion Before Launch? 💰 #gta6 #shorts
videos.description:
Sensor Tower estimated about $1.54 billion in GTA 6 digital pre-orders by Nov 17, roughly 75% on PlayStation. GTA 5 made $815.7 million on day one; Take-Two hasn't shared official GTA 6 sales yet.

Sources: CNN, Forbes, Yahoo Finance (Sensor Tower estimates)
